subject: [PATCH v4 04/13] mm/collapse: add collapse.h for the collapse interface

2026-09-28.patch_summary: This patch adds a new header file, mm/collapse.h, to separate the interface and implementation of the collapse feature from the khugepaged.c file. The collapse feature is used for page migration and memory compaction. The new header file defines an enum for scan results and a struct for control parameters, as well as two constants related to page table entries. This separation improves code organization and maintainability.
